provisional_convention: columns 1-2 are simulation outputs; columns 3-41 are enrichment inputs

statistics.ks: Two-sided empirical CDF distance from Uniform(0.7, 5.0); descriptive only, no hypothesis test
statistics.correlation: Columns 1-2 versus mean of columns 3-41; each input versus mean of the OTHER 38 inputs
statistics.constant_column_correlation: Reported as 0, not evidence of independence

interpretation: The statistics support, but cannot prove, columns 1-2 as outputs. They cannot establish which is k-inf or PPPF without official column-order metadata.
